# Pak Adenium (Pak Adenium Nursery)

> Pak Adenium is a specialist botanical nursery in Pakistan (founded 2018) cultivating rare Desert Rose (*Adenium*) plants, multi-petal grafted blooms, sculptural *Adenium arabicum* caudex bonsai, fresh hand-pollinated Adenium seeds, and porous mineral substrates with nationwide safe delivery across Pakistan.

## Brand & Business Overview
- **Brand Name:** Pak Adenium (Pak Adenium Nursery)
- **Founded:** 2000
- **Location:** Pak Adenium Botanical Farm, Nursery Sector, Multan & Lahore Dispatch Hub, Pakistan
- **Currency & Payments:** PKR (Rs.) — Cash, Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, JazzCash
- **Delivery:** Nationwide safe bare-root and potted dispatch across Pakistan (including Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Multan, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, and Peshawar)

## Core Products & Categories
- **Grafted Varieties:** Multi-petal layered blooms grafted onto 2–3 year acclimated rootstocks.
- **Adenium Arabicum:** Sculptural, fat-caudex desert rose specimens with natural bonsai silhouettes.
- **Rare & Collector Hybrids:** Dorset Horn (*Khao Hin Khon*), Thai *Socotranum* hybrids, and bi-color cultivars.
- **Adenium Obesum:** Resilient Desert Rose plants suited for Pakistan's summer heat (45°C+).
- **Specimen Bonsai:** 4 to 8 year root-trained Adenium bonsai.
- **Seeds & Nursery Care:** Hand-pollinated hybrid Adenium seeds (Pack of 20) and coarse mineral substrates (5kg Bag).

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Where can I buy authentic Adenium plants in Pakistan?**
  Pak Adenium supplies outdoor-acclimated grafted Adeniums, *Adenium arabicum* caudex specimens, rare hybrids, and fresh seeds online with nationwide delivery across Pakistan.
- **How are Desert Rose plants shipped safely across Pakistan?**
  Plants are packed in custom protective packaging (bare-root or potted depending on variety and distance) to arrive healthy with a live unboxing guarantee.
- **What soil mix works best for Adeniums in Pakistan?**
  A fast-draining coarse mineral substrate (sieved pumice, gravel, and charcoal) that prevents soft caudex rot during monsoon humidity.
